# ztna_connector_group (Resource)

ConnectorGroup resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ztna_connector_group" "example" {
  name        = "terraform-test-connector-group"
  description = "Made by Terraform"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the connector group.

It can only be 64 characters long
and contain unicode text, space, dash, or underscore, or period.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the connector group.
- `is_autoscale` (Boolean) Whether the connector group is autoscaled.

If omitted, defaults to false.
- `is_ngfw` (Boolean) Connector group type.

If false (default), the group is a ZTNA Connector group.
If true, the group is an NGFW Connector group.

If omitted, defaults to false.
- `pba_project_name` (String) DPA project name that this connector group will serve.

This field must be provided when the tenant is DPA-enabled,
and must not be provided when the tenant is not DPA-enabled.
- `preserve_user_id` (Boolean) Whether to preserve user ID for this connector group.

If omitted, defaults to false.

### Read-Only

- `created_time` (String) Created time
- `oid` (String) Connector Group ID
- `tfid` (String) The Terraform ID.
- `updated_time` (String) Updated time


## Import

The following command can be used to import a resource not managed by Terraform:

```bash
terraform import ztna_connector_group.example :::oid
```
